about_insurance_body: We hold what each facility says it accepts. We cannot see your own cover, so we can never tell you that you personally are covered — always check at the facility before you rely on it.
about_insurance_title: What we can and cannot tell you about insurance
about_lede: MediLink helps you find healthcare in Rwanda and know what to expect before you travel.
about_privacy_body: Your phone number is how MediLink identifies you and how a facility reaches you when it is your turn. You can export everything held about you, or erase it, from your profile.
about_verified_body: A verified facility is one somebody from MediLink has checked exists, at the location shown, offering the services listed. It is not a rating, an endorsement, or a judgement about quality of care. We do not rate facilities or doctors.
about_wait_body: From the facility's own reception desk, and only once it has recorded enough visits for the figure to mean something. Where there are too few, or a facility does not send us its queue, we say the wait is unavailable. We never estimate one.
about_what_body: It shows you verified facilities near you, what each one says it accepts by way of insurance, when they have free appointments, and — where a facility sends us its queue — how long people are waiting right now.
any_available_body: The facility assigns whoever is free. Usually the soonest.
appointment_arrival_note: You will get an SMS reminder the day before and again two hours ahead.
appointments_no_slots: No free appointments in the next two weeks.
appointments_none_bookable: This facility does not take appointments through MediLink yet. You can still go in person, or ring ahead.
auth_bad_credentials: That username and password did not match.
auth_code_sent_to: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to
auth_consent: I agree to MediLink holding my health records as described in the
auth_full_name_hint: This is the name a facility will call you by.
auth_no_surface: This account is not set up for any MediLink area. Contact support.
auth_phone_hint: This is how we reach you when it is your turn.
auth_privacy_note: Your records are yours. You can export or erase them at any time.
auth_prompt: Sign in to book and track your place in the queue
auth_staff_note: Facility staff accounts are issued by MediLink, not self-registered.
auth_subtitle: Sign in with your username and password.
auth_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_username_rules: 3 or more letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
auth_wrong_surface_body: You are signed in, but this account does not have access to this area.
book_no_slots: No times available in this period.
booking_confirmed: Booked. Bring your reference and insurance card.
booking_insurance_note: MediLink knows this facility accepts your insurer. It cannot confirm your own cover is active - bring your card.
cached_results: Saved {ago}. These may have changed since.
called_off_warning: Switching this off means you may miss your turn.
cancel_note: Cancelling frees the slot for somebody else.
care_guide_body: Tell MediLink what you are experiencing and get guidance toward the right kind of care.
care_guide_disclaimer: This is guidance, not a diagnosis. If you feel very unwell, seek care now.
care_guide_emergency_first: If you feel very unwell, do not wait for these questions. Go to a health facility now.
care_guide_incomplete: These questions did not reach an answer. Search for a facility instead.
care_guide_intro: A few questions to point you at the right service. It is not a diagnosis.
care_guide_no_recommendation: We could not point you at a specific service. Visit your nearest health facility.
care_guide_point_1: Asks you a few questions about how you feel.
care_guide_point_2: Suggests which service to attend - not what you have.
care_guide_point_3: Shows you nearby facilities that offer it.
care_guide_privacy: Your answers are not stored. They are discarded when you finish.
care_guide_result_body: This only points you at a service. A clinician is the one who examines you.
care_guide_step_specialists: Finding the right kind of care
care_guide_symptom_hint: Describe it in your own words, or skip and answer the questions instead.
care_guide_symptom_privacy: Used only to choose where to start. It is not saved.
care_guide_title: Not sure which doctor you need?
care_guide_unavailable: The Care Guide is not available yet. It is awaiting sign-off by a clinician.
care_guide_unavailable_body: You can still search for facilities and doctors in the meantime.
compare_empty_body: Pick two or three facilities to compare them side by side.
compare_partial: {n} facilities could not be loaded. The rest are shown.
districts_unavailable: The district list could not be loaded.
doctor_unverified_note: MediLink has not yet confirmed this profile with the facility. Check with them before you travel.
doctors_body: Find a doctor by specialty, language spoken, or name.
doctors_verification_note: Doctors are listed by their facility. A profile marked not verified has not yet been confirmed by MediLink.
emergency_body: If this is an emergency, don't wait.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_screen_body: Nothing you did caused this, and nothing you have saved is lost. Try again, or go back to the start.
error_screen_title: Something went wrong on this screen
footer_emergency_label: If this is an emergency, do not wait
footer_not_medical_advice: MediLink helps you find and reach care. It does not diagnose, and it does not give medical advice.
footer_tagline: Find verified health facilities near you, check whether they take your insurance, and see how long the wait is before you travel.
have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
help_book_body: Open a facility, choose a service, and pick a time. You will need to be signed in, which takes a phone number and a code we send by SMS. Your booking reference is on the appointment page.
help_contact_body: Ask at the reception desk of any facility using MediLink — they can see your booking and your place in the queue.
help_data_body: Your profile has both. Erasing removes your name, phone number and location from our records; the facility keeps its own attendance counts, with nothing in them that identifies you.
help_data_title: Getting your data, or removing it
help_emergency_body: Do not use MediLink to decide. Call {number} or go to the nearest facility now.
help_queue_body: When a facility checks you in at its desk, your position appears under Visits. If the facility records enough visits for us to be confident, we also tell you roughly when to set off — and we say nothing rather than guess when we cannot.
help_queue_title: Tracking your place in a queue
help_turned_away_body: Insurance information comes from the facility, and it can be out of date. Tell the facility so they can correct it, and please tell us too so we can follow it up.
help_turned_away_title: If a facility turns you away
hero_body: Find trusted hospitals, doctors and services near you. Know before you go.
insurance_accepts_note: We show what a facility accepts, never that you are covered. Confirm at the facility.
insurance_body: Find facilities that accept your insurance.
insurance_disclaimer: This is what each facility says it accepts. It is not confirmation that your own cover is active — check with the facility before you travel.
insurance_intro: Choose your insurance to see which facilities near you accept it, and what each one covers.
insurance_none_nearby: No facility near you has told us it accepts {insurer}. Try another district, or ask the facility directly.
insurance_pick_body: Pick one above and we will show the facilities near you that accept it.
leave_by_needs_home: Set your home location in your profile and we can tell you when to leave.
leave_by_no_estimate: This facility does not have enough queue history yet for a reliable estimate.
location_denied: We could not find your location
map_needs_results: No facilities to show on the map yet.
nearby_needs_a_place_body: Pick your district above and we will show the facilities open near you.
no_active_queue_body: You will appear here once reception checks you in at a facility.
no_doctors_found_body: Try a different specialty or language.
no_doctors_listed_body: This facility has not registered its doctors on MediLink yet.
no_messages_body: You will get messages when you are in a queue or have an appointment.
no_results_body: Try changing your district or insurance filter.
no_slots_body: Try another service, or another facility nearby.
no_slots_provider_body: This doctor has no open times. Any available may be sooner.
onb1_body: Search public and private facilities, check insurance accepted, and confirm appointment availability - all before you leave home.
onb1_title: Find the right doctor near you
onb2_body: Book a slot, then follow your place in the queue from home. We say when to leave when we know.
onb3_body: Tell us how you feel and we point to the right service. It is a guide, not a diagnosis.
out_of_bounds: Your location does not appear to be in Rwanda
preferences_note: Sign-in codes, and a facility cancelling on you, are always sent.
privacy_contact_body: A contact address for data questions will be published before MediLink goes into production.
privacy_draft_warning: This is a draft. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer, and must be before MediLink is used in production.
privacy_rights_body: You can export everything we hold, or erase it, at any time. After erasure a facility keeps its counts, but nobody can tell they were you.
privacy_triage_body: Your Care Guide answers are never stored. What is kept is a count - which service was suggested - with no link to you at all.
privacy_what_insurer: The insurer you chose, so we can show which facilities accept it.
privacy_what_location: Your home location, if you set one - it is what lets us tell you when to leave.
privacy_what_name: Your name, if you gave one.
privacy_what_not: We do not hold test results, diagnoses, treatment records, or payment details.
privacy_what_phone: Your phone number. It is what identifies your account.
privacy_what_visits: Your visits: which facility, when, and for what service.
privacy_who_audit: Every time somebody opens your record it is logged: who, when, and what they looked at.
privacy_who_body: Facility staff see only the patients attending their own facility. They cannot see anyone else's.
profile_home_why: Lets us tell you when to leave. Optional.
profile_save_failed: That change was not saved. Please try again.
queue_called_now: You are being called - {ticket}. Go in.
queue_explainer: Waiting times come from the facility's own reception desk, and only when it has recorded enough visits to be sure. Where we cannot say, we say so rather than guess.
queue_load_failed: Could not check your place in the queue.
queue_load_failed_body: This does not mean you have lost your place. Please try again.
queue_not_reporting: This facility does not send us live queue information, so we cannot tell you how long the wait is.
queue_set_home: Set your home location to see when to leave
radius_expanded: No facilities within {original} km. Showing results within {actual} km.
searching_district: Facilities in {district}. No distances - we do not know where you are.
service_insurance_note: Insurance coverage differs by facility. Open a facility to see what it accepts for this service.
services_intro: Browse what facilities near you offer, and find the ones that provide what you need.
sign_in_to_book_body: Searching does not need an account. Booking does, so the facility knows who is coming.
sign_in_to_track: Sign in to track your queue
slot_taken: That time has just been taken.
sms_note: These are sent by SMS, so they reach you without internet.
splash_sub: Find care, book, track - in minutes.
ussd_hint: No smartphone? Dial {code} on any phone
value_insurance_body: See which facilities accept your cover before you travel.
value_nearby_body: Verified facilities, with the real distance.
value_wait_body: When we do not know, we say so rather than guess.
visits_cancel_failed: Could not cancel that appointment. Please try again.
visits_none_body: When you book an appointment, it will appear here.
wait_unavailable_explained: Live queue data isn't available for this facility.
wait_unavailable_list: Live wait times aren't reported by these facilities yet.
